confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are less certain because nightly rates vary widely by district, season and booking lead time, so they are bounded estimates for a typical July stay. Drink anchors are based on general knowledge of Taipei bar and restaurant pricing, cross-checked against the local beer price level. The FX figure came from a search summary attributed to the RBA homepage, dated 15 October 2026; I did not open the RBA page directly, and a third-party site reported a slightly different figure for 16 October, which I did not use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on East Asian mid-sized capitals with similar tourism profiles and price levels, such as Seoul and Osaka, with Taipei's lower accommodation and dining costs taken into account.
